items.title_orig: River’s contribution to the LGBTQ+ community
items.article_text: Pride Month is almost ending, and more people should talk about how revolutionary it was for River to take such a risky role during the peak of his career. He gave his all to Mike’s character. Mike was supposed to be a straight character, but he choose to play him differently, and he wrote the entire Mike’s confession to Scott. Homophobia was still very much present in Hollywood, and he handled it with such care, respect and attention. It wasn’t just a “role” for him, he really took care of Mike, without him, and the beautiful scene he wrote, My Own Private Idaho would have been just another generic movie.
